notes: 8 configurations, 4 manufacturers (BINDER, ESPEC incl. Qualmark EXT line, Thermotron, Memmert), all with every core passport key sourced (not_found empty). Covers climatic -40 C (BINDER MK 240), humidity -70 C (MKFT 240), ultra-low -75 C (Memmert TT300E75), LN2 rapid cycling to -100 C (ESPEC EXT2.0), air-to-air thermal shock (ESPEC TSD-101-W, mechanical; Thermotron ATS-320-V-LN2, LN2), EV battery charge-discharge chamber (ESPEC ADBC-T) and temperature-altitude chamber with vacuum to 8 torr (Thermotron FA-16-CH-5-5). Conventions follow sibling files: magnet absence = not_available/unknown from complete spec; vacuum.available installed flag false for atmospheric air chambers; pressure.base not_available; optional window/ports = optional_not_installed flag true; cryogen.type empty set for compressor machines. electrical.sample_connections=true for standard cable access/entry ports or cable tubes (manufacturer-stated purpose for ESPEC TSD/ADBC; BINDER/Memmert/Thermotron ports are pass-throughs with no installed wiring) - integrator may prefer to treat bare ports differently. Weaker absences: optical_access not_available for ESPEC ADBC-T and Memmert TT300E75 rests on complete spec/option lists that list no window. sample.diameter.max = smaller of interior width and depth per family_mapping. temperature.sweep_rate.max stores the slower of heating/cooling averages (BINDER) or the slower guaranteed ramp (ADBC, 50 K/60 min rounded down to 833 mK/min); EXT2.0 70 C/min is empty-chamber average. Thermotron ATS-320-V-LN2 temperature range is the family figure -73 to 200 C; its LN2-only status is read from the model suffix and footnotes (LN2 optional only on ** models). Thermotron FA access port is standard on the current web page but listed as option in the 2017 brochure. Not covered: inTEST ThermoStream (datasheets behind a request form), LNG/LH2 vehicle tank rigs and ASTM D2137 brittleness testers (no reachable manufacturer spec; web search quota exhausted), Weiss Technik (site would not render), CSZ (expired TLS certificate).
